CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS partners_settings (id VARCHAR(40) PRIMARY KEY,data MEDIUMTEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS partners_product_policies (product_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,data TEXT NOT NULL,updated_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS partners_rules (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,scope VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,target_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,rate_bps INTEGER NOT NULL,starts_at VARCHAR(40),ends_at VARCHAR(40),budget_minor INTEGER,spent_minor INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,data TEXT NOT NULL,active TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,INDEX partners_rules_lookup (scope,target_id,active))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS partners_commissions (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,order_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,line_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,affiliate_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,link_id VARCHAR(64),campaign_id VARCHAR(64),state VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,amount_minor INTEGER NOT NULL,reversed_minor INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,paid_minor INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,payable_at VARCHAR(40),data MEDIUMTEXT NOT NULL,created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,updated_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,UNIQUE KEY partners_order_line (order_id,line_id),INDEX partners_affiliate_state (affiliate_id,state,created_at),INDEX partners_maturity (state,payable_at),INDEX partners_campaign (campaign_id,created_at))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS partners_ledger (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,commission_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,affiliate_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,event_key VARCHAR(190) NOT NULL UNIQUE,kind VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,amount_minor INTEGER NOT NULL,data TEXT NOT NULL,created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,INDEX partners_ledger_affiliate (affiliate_id,created_at))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS partners_financial_events (id VARCHAR(190) PRIMARY KEY,order_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,kind VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,data TEXT NOT NULL,created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,INDEX partners_event_order (order_id,created_at))
